cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-open-lists-chats-and-close-releases
cases.purpose: Opening shows the account's chats in one buffer; closing kills it.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-filter-shows-matching-chats
cases.purpose: A filter tab narrows the list and the main tab restores it.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-filter-keys-cycle
cases.purpose: [ and ] walk the list's filter tabs and narrow the visible conversations.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-list-keys-move-and-open
cases.purpose: n and p walk the list and RET opens the conversation under point.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-chat-with-opens-by-name
cases.purpose: Known conversations are offered by name and the chosen one opens.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-open-chat-shows-history-and-lands-on-composer
cases.purpose: Opening a chat replaces the list with its history, oldest first.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-back-returns-to-the-list
cases.purpose: q leaves the chat for the list with that conversation under point.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-message-keys-walk-history-and-composer
cases.purpose: p selects older messages and n past the newest returns to the composer.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-jump-newest-selects-the-newest-message
cases.purpose: > shows the newest message from anywhere in the history.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-composer-sends-and-clears-on-ack
cases.purpose: Typing in the composer sends the text and clears it after acceptance.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-input-history-recalls-sent-texts
cases.purpose: M-p and M-n recall the texts sent in the open conversation.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-send-options-reach-the-backend
cases.purpose: Silent, preview, schedule and markdown options ride on the next send.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-clear-draft-discards-the-composer
cases.purpose: C-c C-d clears a draft and leaves the composer.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-draft-survives-until-ack
cases.purpose: A pending send keeps the draft and clears only after acceptance.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-leaving-the-composer-keeps-the-draft
cases.purpose: Cancelling plain typing keeps the text as the chat's draft.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-reply-quotes-the-selected-message
cases.purpose: r arms a reply to the message under point and the sent message quotes it.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-edit-replaces-and-cancel-restores-the-draft
cases.purpose: e edits an outgoing message; cancelling an edit restores the old draft.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-edit-refuses-incoming-messages
cases.purpose: Only the account's own messages can be edited.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-live-changes-update-the-open-chat
cases.purpose: Arrivals append once, updates replace in place and deletions remove.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-load-more-prepends-older-pages
cases.purpose: Older pages load above the history until the chat's first message.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-jump-loads-and-selects-a-message
cases.purpose: Jumping to an unloaded message loads its page and selects it.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-jumps-reach-quoted-pinned-and-dated-messages
cases.purpose: Quoted, pinned and dated jumps select the right message.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-next-unread-chat-moves-to-the-unread-one
cases.purpose: M-g u on the list selects the next conversation with unread messages.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-fastnav-walks-unread-mentions-and-outgoing
cases.purpose: M-g u/m/o select unread, mentioning and outgoing messages.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-day-separators-label-each-date
cases.purpose: Each new date opens with a day label; today reads as 今天.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-activate-opens-media-or-composes
cases.purpose: RET on a media message opens it through Telega; elsewhere it composes.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-telega-keys-run-native-commands
cases.purpose: Telega's own keys run Telega's commands on the chat or message at point.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-chat-action-keys-run-native-commands
cases.purpose: M, A and L run Telega's mute, archive and leave on the conversation under point.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-theme-switch-repaints-the-client
cases.purpose: Toggling the theme swaps the palette and keeps the open chat.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-viewer-pages-and-closes-in-the-buffer
cases.purpose: A photo opens in the in-buffer viewer, pages between media messages and closes back to the chat.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-react-toggles-a-visible-reaction
cases.purpose: Toggling a reaction shows the emoji on the message and toggling again removes it.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-own-messages-align-with-everyone-else
cases.purpose: Outgoing and incoming messages share one left-aligned layout.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-swipes-go-back-and-change-filters
cases.purpose: Swiping right leaves a chat and horizontal swipes on the list change the filter.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-printing-keys-never-edit-the-history
cases.purpose: Unbound printing keys on a message never insert text into the history.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-search-finds-opens-and-remembers-chats
cases.purpose: List search filters conversations, opens the first match and lists it as recent until cleared.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-chat-search-and-details-pane
cases.purpose: Message search narrows the open history and the details pane toggles on demand.
